verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own docs state that publishing deploys the app and its Payload backend to Figma's hosted infrastructure, and that you can assign a custom domain, which implies a live URL. The docs never describe the flow as a single step, and no hands-on report confirms it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a one-click publish flow, explicit mention of the default live URL produced, independent or hands-on corroboration of the publish experience.

support.subject: As a founder, I can publish my app to a live URL in one step

citations.quote: Publishing deploys your app and its Payload backend to Figma’s hosted infrastructure.
You can also assign a custom domain that you own.
Figma stores it securely so your app can use it without exposing the key to visitors when you publish.
